summary: The accepted commit-duration falsifier verdict requires a clean unpaced control: a majority of paced production-like rounds exceeding the unchanged 100ms P99 target still sets threshold_status=exceeded, but a fired verdict additionally requires the in-run unpaced acceptance round to exceed the same target, so a paced overshoot with a clean control resolves to falsifier_status=inconclusive with the reason host scheduling. Correctness precedence, population authority, and CD-0051 D2's diagnostic wall and begin-wait measurements are unchanged.
title: The commit-duration falsifier requires a clean unpaced control
